summary: The fixed simply connected Wu manifold answers Hanke's printed 2010 actual-free rank question: free toral and free 2-ranks zero, free p-rank one for every odd prime; a classical explanatory note with a proof covering arbitrary continuous actions.
priority_summary: Classical inputs credited. Earlier CWY–Mundet examples already have actual free cyclic actions for every odd prime and no nontrivial continuous circle action; their nonabelian fundamental groups exclude them from this target. Priority remains unresolved; no firstness, certified novelty or current worldwide-open certification.
